title: Print cover
description: cover/cover.json: the full-wrap print cover's settings, versioned drafts, approval and cover preflight. A book without this file is a legacy interior-only project.

artwork.description: 'native' (the default when absent): the wrap is built around registered cover-front-artwork, which must reach 300 DPI at its printed size. 'none': a deliberately text-only cover with no artwork asset; every other cover check still applies. Set it with `bookfactory cover artwork`, which records who chose it.

subtitle.description: Optional line set beneath the title on the front panel by `cover build`.

approved.description: The finalized cover. `path` is the tracked, checksummed draft it was promoted from (read-only once approved); output/cover.pdf is only a regenerable upload copy. Records written before `path` existed resolve to the draft of the same revision when its sha256 matches.

authorization.description: Present only when an agent approved the cover under the recorded production policy (`cover approve --autonomous`), e.g. 'autonomous_production_policy:autonomous'. Absent for an operator approval.

design.description: Optional look-and-feel overrides read by `cover build`. Fonts are paths to .ttf/.otf files inside this book's project (e.g. style/fonts/Title.ttf).

title_over_artwork.description: Set the title over the top of the front artwork, for art drawn with an empty band there.

title_top_in.description: With title_over_artwork: how far below the artwork's top edge the title starts, in inches (default 0.35).

artwork.description: The artwork mode the draft was checked under. Absent on drafts submitted before text-only covers existed, which were all 'native'.
